tasks.question: Calculate the minimum total development sample size for a binary clinical prediction model using the Riley criteria as implemented by pmsampsize 1.1.3. There are 24 candidate predictor parameters (excluding intercept), prevalence 0.174 and anticipated adjusted Cox-Snell R-squared 0.288. Use shrinkage 0.90 and the package default precision criteria; do not use events-per-variable rules. Precision uses 95% confidence and maximum absolute apparent-versus-adjusted R-squared difference 0.05 (Nagelkerke scale for binary/survival). Target average outcome-risk absolute margin of error 0.05; for survival verify this precision at the returned package sample size.
